title: Laser Hair Removal Preparation Guide
h1: How to prepare for laser hair removal: shaving, sun and skincare
desc: How to prepare for laser hair removal: when to shave, what to avoid before your session, sun exposure, skincare and medicines. A clear checklist from Skin & Laser.
answer: Shave the area 12 to 24 hours before your session, and don't wax, thread, pluck or epilate for 4 weeks beforehand, because the laser needs the hair root in place. Avoid sun, tanning and self-tanner for 2 weeks, stop retinoids and exfoliating acids on the area a few days before, and tell us about any medicines.
facts: Clean skin, no creams or deodorant
body:
## Your checklist

- Shave the treatment area the day before, or the morning of your session
- Remove make-up, creams, deodorant and self-tanner from the area
- Wear loose, comfortable clothing
- Arrive with skin that isn't sunburnt or irritated

## Medicines and health

Some medicines make skin more sensitive to light, including certain antibiotics and acne treatments such as isotretinoin. Tell us about everything you take. Laser hair removal is usually postponed during pregnancy.

## After your session

Aftercare matters just as much. Read our [aftercare guide](/blog/laser-hair-removal-aftercare/).
faq: Why can't I wax before laser?
Waxing removes the root, which the laser needs to target.
Yes, shaving is the best way to manage hair between sessions.
Can I have laser after a beach holiday?
Wait until any tan has faded, usually 2 to 4 weeks.
